title: 第3章 武魂觉醒终复明第4章 族比将至叶家弟子的挑衅
content_zh:
半夜，叶无尘从昏迷中醒来，此时的他正躺在柔软的床榻之上。
“玉佩...”
叶无尘似乎是想起了什么一般，他转头看向腰间。
原本悬挂在腰间的玉佩此时已然消失不见，似乎在告诉叶无尘，他昏迷前所经历的一切并不是梦。
“难道是魂宫！”
昏迷前，他亲眼看到玉佩融入了他的眉心，而眉心处乃是魂宫所在的地方。
豁然闭上双眼，心神遁入魂宫之中。
魂宫之内，意识所化的叶无尘虚影出现在这片寂静的空间内。
他的脚下，一株三寸高的翠绿树苗正扎根在这片荒芜的大地之上。
树苗通体碧绿，枝叶之上闪烁着淡淡的幽光。
若是仔细查看便能发现，树苗的某些叶片之上，似乎雕刻着一些玄妙的符文，显得格外神秘。
而当叶无尘看到这株树苗的刹那，脸上露出了一抹十分震惊的表情。
他不由得想起了小时候母亲将一枚玉佩交给自己的时候说过的话。
“小尘，这枚玉佩你拿着，这是娘送给你的礼物，以后，它会长成一棵苍天古树，代替爹爹与娘亲保护你。”
……
“小尘乖，不要怕，爹爹跟娘亲会保护你，古树也会保护你。”
……
“你把它挂在腰间，等时机成熟了，它自然会长出嫩芽，到时候你可要好好照顾它哦。”
往事一幕幕浮现在叶无尘的脑海中。
“原来娘说的都是真的...”

叶无尘看向空荡荡的腰间，内心不由得涌现出一股暖流。
然而就在这时，叶无尘脚下，那株树苗最下方的一片嫩叶竟开始闪烁出耀眼的光芒。
不多时，一道白色的光团从嫩叶中浮现，随即没入叶无尘的身体之中。
顿时，叶无尘感觉到自己似乎正被无数把钝刀切割着肉体与经脉。
他不由得发出一道闷哼声，脸上露出一抹痛苦的神色。
叶无尘紧咬牙关，豆大的汗珠从他的额头上划过脸颊，最终滴落地面。
一个时辰后，疼痛感渐渐消散，叶无尘瘫坐在地上，显得十分疲惫。
但他脸上的笑容却是格外的灿烂。
此刻，他的肌肤显得光滑如玉，散发着淡淡的光泽，经脉与骨骼也变得更加坚韧。
甚至，叶无尘没有发现的是，他的体内，有极小一部分的血液化作淡金之色，显得格外高贵。
“淬炼肉身，洗精伐髓！”
洗精伐髓乃是炼体后三重所需要进行的过程。
而如今，叶无尘在炼体之初便已经做到，这对于他的武道之路会有着许多好处。
此刻，那片嫩叶之上的翠绿之色缓缓黯淡。
最后仿佛枯萎了一般，掉落在地上，被泥土掩盖。
再次看向脚下的这株树苗，叶无尘只感觉内心十分震惊。
武魂乃是武者最重要的东西，境界越高，武魂对于武者的助力也就越大。
一般情况下，在炼体一境，武魂的存在顶多让武者的气血更为旺盛，除此之外就没有什么用了。
可叶无尘从来没有听说过，有什么武魂能在武者修行之初便给予这么大的帮助。
content_en:
In the middle of the night, Ye Wuchen woke up from his coma. At this time, he was lying on the soft bed.
"Jade pendant..."
Ye Wuchen seemed to have remembered something. He turned his head and looked at his waist.
The jade pendant originally hanging around his waist had disappeared at this time, seeming to tell Ye Wuchen that everything he experienced before he fell into coma was not a dream.
"Could it be the Soul Palace!"
Before he fell into coma, he saw with his own eyes that the jade pendant had merged into his eyebrows, where the Soul Palace was located.
Suddenly closing his eyes, his mind escaped into the Soul Palace.
In the Soul Palace, Ye Wuchen's shadow transformed by his consciousness appeared in this silent space.
Under his feet, a three-inch-tall green sapling was taking root in this barren land.
The saplings are all green, with a faint light shining on the branches and leaves.
If you look closely, you will find that some mysterious runes seem to be carved on some leaves of the sapling, which makes them look particularly mysterious.
When Ye Wuchen saw the sapling, a very shocked expression appeared on his face.
He couldn't help but think of what his mother said when he handed a jade pendant to him when he was a child.
"Xiaochen, take this jade pendant. This is a gift from mother to you. In the future, it will grow into an ancient tree in the sky and protect you on behalf of father and mother."
…
"Xiao Chen, be good, don't be afraid, your father and mother will protect you, and the ancient tree will also protect you."
…
"You hang it around your waist, and when the time is right, it will naturally grow buds. You have to take good care of it when the time comes."
Scenes from the past appeared in Ye Wuchen's mind.
"It turns out that everything my mother said is true..."
Ye Wuchen looked at his empty waist, and couldn't help but feel a warm current in his heart.
However, at this moment, under Ye Wuchen's feet, a young leaf at the bottom of the sapling began to shine with dazzling light.
Not long after, a white light group emerged from the young leaves, and then disappeared into Ye Wuchen's body.
Suddenly, Ye Wuchen felt as if his flesh and meridians were being cut by countless blunt knives.
He couldn't help but let out a muffled sound, with a look of pain on his face.
Ye Wuchen gritted his teeth, and large beads of sweat ran from his forehead across his cheeks, eventually dripping to the ground.
An hour later, the pain gradually dissipated, and Ye Wuchen collapsed on the ground, looking very tired.
But the smile on his face was exceptionally bright.
At this moment, his skin appeared as smooth as jade, exuding a faint luster, and his meridians and bones became stronger.
Even what Ye Wuchen didn't notice was that a very small part of the blood in his body turned into a pale gold color, making it look particularly noble.
"Tempering the body, washing the essence and cutting the marrow!"
Washing the essence and cutting the marrow is the process that needs to be carried out in the third level after body refining.
But now, Ye Wuchen has already done it at the beginning of his body training, which will have many benefits for his martial arts path.
At this moment, the emerald green color on the young leaf slowly dimmed.
Finally, it seemed to wither, fall to the ground, and be covered by the soil.
Looking at the sapling at his feet again, Ye Wuchen felt very shocked inside.
Martial spirit is the most important thing for a warrior. The higher the realm, the greater the help the martial spirit can give to a warrior.
Under normal circumstances, in the first level of body refining, the existence of martial souls can at most make the warrior's energy and blood more vigorous, but it has no use other than that.
But Ye Wuchen had never heard of any martial spirit that could provide such great help to a warrior at the beginning of his training.
